description_html:
VEIKK Creator Pop VK430


The 290 PPS high report rate is designed for osu! gamer, you can also use it to Draw, Sketch, Sign on PDF or Edit pictures with 4 efficient cutomizable shortcuts. Put it in the pocket with the smallest size!


Designed for osu! Gamer: the report rate is higher to 290 PPS, which makes it easier to control the line quicker and smoother. The P05 Battery-free pen, allowing you constant uninterrupted playing osu!. 16384 levels of pressure sensitivity can identify any subtle strokes, accurately determine the mouse position, and hit the rhythm. To play faster, driver installation recommended.


Ultra-thin and Ultra-lightweight: Thinner to 2mm, with 82.5g lightweight and a 4x3 inch active area. Not take up your working space and easily fits into a laptop case or in a schoolbag, convenient to carry with you on the go.


Efficient and Ergonomic: Comes with 4 customizable Express Keys that allow you to switch to a different program or favorite shortcuts like undo or zoom in/out at your fingertips on the driver. Get work done efficiently and save your time. USB-C port design which allows to plug in and out in either direction is more convenient and stable. It supports both right and left-hander.


Easily switch among different programs: Supports digital drawing, painting, sketching, E-signatures, online teaching, remote work, photo editing, etc. It’s compatible with Windows 7 and above, Mac OS 10.12 and above, Android 6.0 and above (Check Android FAQs first to see if your phone supported) with the OTG connector【NEED PURCHASE SEPARATELY】, and Linux OS. You can use it on the creative program like Adobe Photoshop, paint tool sai, illustrator, Corel draw, Corel painter, sketchbook, manga studio, clip studio paint, and more.


Ideal tool for Signature or E-learning: An ideal tool for online teaching, e-learning, remote work, or Signature, it's compatible with Microsoft Office programs like Word, PowerPoint, OneNote, Zoom, etc. Works perfect than a mouse, visually present your handwritten notes, signatures precisely. Download your products’ driver on VEIKK website to get a better experience.


Start YourDrawing Journey Naturally

For beginners learning digital sketching and illustration, VK430 focuses on delivering a stable and natural drawing experience.

A 4×3-inch compact active area helps users maintain control and build accurate hand-eye coordination, while 16384 levels of pressure sensitivity ensure smooth stroke variation from light sketching to bold lines.


Learn, Practice, Improve Anytime

For students practicing digital art or using drawing software for the first time, portability and ease of use matter most.

At only 82.5g with a slim 2mm design, VK430 tablet is easy to carry and set up anywhere, making it ideal for classroom learning or home practice sessions.

Capture Ideas Anytime Inspiration Hits

For casual sketching and idea capture, responsiveness and simplicity are key.

VK430 responds quickly to input with a 290 PPS report rate, ensuring smooth and immediate reaction when drawing or jotting down ideas.


Write Naturally, Like Pen On Paper

For handwriting, annotation, signing documents, and online study, precision and writing stability are essential.

A small active area allows accurate pen control, while 16384 pressure sensitivity helps create natural handwriting variation similar to pen-on-paper writing.


Play Rhythm Games

For OSU-style rhythm games and other fast-paced cursor-based interactions, timing and accuracy are essential.

With a 290 PPS report rate, VK430 drawing tablet delivers fast response, while stable tracking ensures precise and consistent control during rapid movements.


Efficient Than You think

Creator Pop VK430 pen tablet comes with 4 customizable Shortcut Keys that allow you to switch to a different program or favorite shortcuts like undo or zoom in/out at your fingertips on the driver. Get work done efficiently and save your time.


Plug and Play Simplicity

Connect instantly through the stable, reversible USB-C port.

Quick setup makes VK430 easy to use for students and first-time drawing tablet users.


Designed for Comfortable Use

VK430 pen tablet supports both left- and right-handed users.

Rotate the tablet between 90°and 270°to match your natural writing or drawing position, ensuring comfortable hand movement during study, signing, or creative sessions.


To the platform you love

Creator Pop VK430 drawing tablet is compatible with Windows 7 or later, macOS 10.12 or later, Android 6.0 or later, and Linux. Easily switch, post your work, and express yourself on social media.


Value for different fields

Compatible with widely used creative, educational, and office software, including:

Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Clip Studio Paint, Microsoft Office, OneNote, Zoom, and other commonly used applications for drawing, note-taking, signing, and online teaching.

Value for starting your different joyful experience from the Veikk Creator Pop VK430!


What’s in the Box

1 x Pen Tablet

8 x Pen Nibs

1 x USB-C Cable

1 x P05 Battery-free Pen

1 x Nib Extractor

1 x Quick Start Guide

description_html_ar:
اكتب وارسم على جرافيك تابلت VEIKK VK640 والتي تبلٌغ مساحته 3x4 بوصة، ويتميز بحجمه الصغير مما يجعله سهل الحمل في الجيب فهو رفيع للغاية وخفيف الوزن: بسماكة 2 مم فقط، ووزن 82.5 جرام


تتيح مساحة العمل الصغيرة تحكمًا دقيقًا بالقلم كما يُمكنك تدوير الجهاز اللوحي بين 90° و270° ليناسب وضعية الكتابة أو الرسم الطبيعية لديك، مما يضمن حركة يد مريحة أثناء الدراسة أو التوقيع أو جلسات الإبداع.


التوقيع الرقمي

أداة احترافية مخصصة لتوقيع المستندات والمعاملات الإلكترونية بدقة عالية جداً وبخط يد طبيعي.


اختصر وقتك

مزود بـ 4 مفاتيح اختصار تتيح لك التبديل بين البرامج المختلفة أو استخدام اختصاراتك المفضلة، مثل التراجع أو التكبير/التصغير، بسهولة تامة. 

اكتب بشكل طبيعي، كما لو كنت تكتب قلم على الورق مع قلم لا يحتاج إلى بطارية أو شحن للعمل، يدعم 16 ألف مستوى من مستويات حساسية الضغط.


يتوافق الجهاز اللوحي بأنظمة التشغيل : 

Windows 10 أو أحدث

Mac OS X 10.12 أو أحدث 

Linux

 Android 6.0 أو أحدث 


يمكنك تشغيل تابلت الرسم مع البرامج الرئيسية مثل :  

Photoshop وKrita وIllustrator وSAI وSketchBook Pro وFire Alpaca وOpen Canvas وManga Studio وibisPaint وMedibang وغيرها.


المحتويات

1x جرافيك تابلت 

1x قلم بدون بطارية 

8 x سنون

1 x USB-C Cable

1 x Nib Extractor 

1 x دليل التشغيل
